hero.title: Give your child an outstanding Quranic education
hero.title_html: Give your child an outstanding Quranic education
hero.subtitle: Looking for a modern daara that combines Quran memorization, discipline and personal growth? Al Amine Academy guides your child toward both spiritual and academic success.

home.problems_subtitle: You are not alone. Hundreds of parents share the same concerns.
home.problem_external_text: Finding a reliable daara that delivers real results in Quran memorization while maintaining solid academic standards.
home.problem_internal_text: The fear that your child might lose their values, fall behind academically, or fail to thrive in a controlled environment.
home.problem_philosophical_text: Every child deserves an education that nurtures both mind AND soul, that strengthens faith without compromising the academic future.
home.guide_text: Since 2023, Al Amine Academy has supported families in Senegal in this delicate quest: providing an excellent Islamic education while ensuring each child's well-being and academic success.
home.plan_subtitle: A transparent and easy process to enroll your child.
home.plan_step1_text: Fill out our online registration form. It only takes a few minutes.
home.plan_step2_text: Your child is placed in the program that matches their age and goals.
home.plan_step3_text: Personalized follow-up with regular reports. You see your child's progress in real time.
home.programs_subtitle: Each program is designed to meet your child's specific needs.
home.testimonials_subtitle: Discover the transformations and successes of our students through their families' testimonials.
home.failure_text: Every year of waiting is a year your child does not build the foundation of a structured Islamic education.
home.final_cta_text: Ready to give your child an outstanding Islamic education? Registrations are open for all our programs.
home.failure_text2: Join the 200+ families who already trust Al Amine Academy.

about.hero_subtitle: Your trusted partner for your child's academic and spiritual excellence.
about.mission_text: Provide a holistic education that combines memorization of the Noble Quran with solid academic training.
about.vision_text: Become the leading reference for modern Quranic schools in West Africa.
about.mission_text1: DAARA Al Amine Academy is a modern Quranic boarding school founded in 2023 in Dakar, in the Cité des Magistrats. Our mission is to give children an outstanding Islamic education, anchored in the Quran and open to the academic world.
about.mission_text2: We believe every child can combine Quran memorization, academic success and personal growth — when the environment and supervision are at the right level.
about.cta_text: Contact us to schedule a guided tour and meet our pedagogical team.

contact.hero_subtitle: A question about our programs? Need information? Our team is here to help.
contact.phone_hours: Available Monday to Saturday, 8 AM – 6 PM
contact.address: Cité des Magistrats, behind Kër Yoff, Dakar
contact.address_full: Behind Kër Yoff, Liberté 6 Extension, Dakar, Senegal
contact.hours_text:
Monday – Friday: 8:00 am – 6:00 pm
Saturday: 9:00 am – 1:00 pm
contact.directions_text: 5 min from Liberté 6, accessible by DDD bus and clandos. Parking on site.
contact.faq_q1: What documents are needed for registration?
contact.faq_a1: Child's birth certificate, ID photo, latest school report, medical certificate and copy of the parent's ID.
contact.faq_q2: What is the minimum age to enroll a child?
contact.faq_a2: From age 6 for the Tahfiz program, and from age 7 for the academic program. Contact us for special cases.
contact.faq_q3: Can we visit the school before enrolling?
contact.faq_a3: Yes, we encourage visits. Call us to schedule an appointment.

admission.hero_subtitle: Join DAARA Al Amine Academy by following our simple and transparent registration steps.
admission.step1_text: Enter your child's information and the desired program. It only takes a few minutes.
admission.step2_text: Our team will contact you within 48 hours to schedule an interview and a school visit.
admission.step3_text: Final registration after acceptance. Your child joins their class at the next session.
admission.final_text: The online registration form only takes a few minutes.
